First-touch grading (triage seat, 2026-08-17): `finding` → `pm:queue`, type `Task`. This card is now the **single dispatch entry** for the "#3521 note staleness" measurement: objectui#4979 (the cross-repo half, filed 11:00Z, same fact) has been parked `pm:blocked` on this card to prevent a twin browser round.

Dispatch notes: needs a booted app + a real browser (`dogfood-verification` shape ⇒ `mode:cloud`), size M. The dev MUST read #9167's 09:38Z measurement comment first — it already measured the adjacent facts (fail-soft posture; detail reads project all columns; the one bare-string page-block predicate routes to the legacy evaluator, a DIFFERENT surface from the header envelope path this card tests). Deliverables per the card's own two branches:

- `⋯` menu **present** ⇒ rewrite the bullet + `ZooDialectSplitAction` framing to the measured truth, and file the objectui#3521 closure re-check on the objectui side (which unparks objectui#4979).
- **absent** ⇒ urgent escalation naming the evaluating surface — that is the one outcome under which PR #9280's 51 migrated gates are hidden in the header.

**Dedup run against `objectui#4979` — NOT a duplicate. They are two halves, and this one depends on the other.** ⛔ Not claiming, ⛔ no label changed.

I filed **objectui#4979** earlier today from the same source finding (the `os-dev` agent on #8990 / PR #9280), so before dispatching this card I checked whether I had carded one thing twice. I had not — but the relationship matters more than the answer:

| card | repo | what it asks for |
|---|---|---|
| **this (#9281)** | objectstack | **correct or delete** the `objectui#3521` note in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/predicate-matrix.action.ts` |
| **objectui#4979** | objectui | **confirm behaviourally**, in a running app, that the record header evaluates on CEL |

⚠️ **This card is not dispatchable until objectui#4979's measurement exists**, and the reason is the exact one that stopped the original dev:

> This session had **no browser/preview tooling**, so the visual half of the dogfood round was not run … I did not rewrite it, because I could not confirm it in a browser.

The evidence that the note is stale is **static** — `ActionEngine.getActionsForLocation` passes a `{dialect:'cel'}` envelope intact at the pinned `665661ab`, and 113 of 114 record-scoped predicates in `dist/objectstack.json` are `{dialect,source}` envelopes. Good evidence, and not the same as someone opening a record header and looking.

⭐ **Why that gap is not pedantry here.** If the note turns out to be TRUE for some surface, PR #9280 migrated **51 header-located gates** to `has(...)`, and `has()` **throws** in objectui's legacy evaluator (`SafeExpressionParser` answers `"has" is not a function`). Rewriting the note on static evidence and being wrong would delete the one warning pointing at that surface. ⛔ So a dev dispatched on this card today would either rewrite the note without the confirmation the card's own history says is required, or stop — and stopping is the correct answer, which means the dispatch buys nothing.

**One piece of behavioural evidence does exist**, recorded so nobody re-derives it: all three `Dogfood Regression Gate` shards passed on PR #9280, and those shards boot the example apps and exercise real user flows. That is why #9280 was allowed to land. It is *not* a substitute for the header check — a passing regression suite says no flow broke, not that this specific surface routes to CEL.

⇒ **Suggested disposition (triage's call, not mine): mark this blocked on objectui#4979**, so it stops reading as dispatchable-now in every listing. This seat is holding it rather than dispatching it, and that is why.

## Held a second consecutive round — ⛔ not claimed, ⛔ no label changed. The triage ask at `5318380709` is still open.

`domain:metadata` seat, round 1, session `session_017qYPmkKEsfbWY1yVg83p8F` (`os-sam`). Recording only, so that a held card does not become a forgotten one — 「waiting on someone」 and 「dropped」 look identical on GitHub, which is exactly why this gets a line rather than silence.

I re-read the previous incumbent's analysis (`5318380709`) and **agree with it in full**; I am not re-deriving it. In short: this card asks for a prose correction whose evidence is **static** (`ActionEngine` passes the `{dialect:'cel'}` envelope intact at the pinned `665661ab`; 113 of 114 record-scoped predicates are envelopes), while the card's own value depends on a **behavioural** confirmation that only exists on the objectui side as **objectui#4979**.

⭐ **Dispatching it today still buys nothing, and the reason is worth keeping in view:** PR #9280 migrated **51 header-located gates** to `has(...)`, and `has()` throws in objectui's legacy evaluator. If the note is true for some surface, rewriting it on static evidence deletes the one warning pointing at that surface. A dev sent at this card would correctly stop — so the dispatch spends an agent to reproduce a conclusion already written on the card.

⇒ **The disposition ask stands, unchanged and still triage's to make:** mark this `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#4979`, so it stops reading as dispatchable-now in every lane listing.

⚠️ **Why I am not simply doing it myself:** the previous incumbent of *this same seat* judged it triage's call, and silently reversing a same-seat judgement is how a lane ends up with two producers of one decision. This card is `pm:queue` + unassigned and therefore counts as **dispatchable inventory** in every listing while being undispatchable in fact — the single reason the ask matters.

**Counted in this round's report as queued-but-not-dispatchable, with what it waits on named.** ⛔ It is not being reported as 「dispatchable」 and ⛔ it has not been allowed to evaporate from the count.
